stem: Mang Tomas borrowed ₱20,000 at 5% simple interest per year. How much interest will he pay after 3 years?
hints: Simple interest: I = P × r × t (principal × rate × time).
Find 5% of ₱20,000 for one year, then multiply by 3.

solution.methodName: Simple interest: I = P × r × t

steps.action: Let I = the interest in pesos.
Use I = P × r × t with P = ₱20,000, r = 5% per year and t = 3 years.
steps.why: P (the principal) is the money borrowed. r is the rate per year. t is the time in years.

steps.action: Check: ₱3,000 ÷ 3 years = ₱1,000 per year, and ₱1,000 is 5% of ₱20,000. He pays ₱3,000 in interest.

trapNotes.₱1,000: This is the interest for 1 year only. Multiply by 3 years.
trapNotes.₱23,000: This is the total he pays back (₱20,000 + ₱3,000). The question asks for the interest only.
